title: Bigg Boss 18's Digvijay Rathee, Chahat Pandey To Join The 50? What We Know | Bigg-boss News - News18
text: Looks like 2026 has kicked off with a flood of reality shows. After Shark Tank India Season 5 and Splitsvilla X6, another reality show that’s already creating major buzz is The 50. While the show is set to premiere on February 1, excitement around its contestant lineup has already taken over the internet. As per The Times of India, the confirmed contestant list has just gotten more exciting, with two contestants from Bigg Boss 18 joining the show. Digvijay Rathee And Chahat Pandey To Join The 50? The new names doing the rounds are Bigg Boss 18 contestants Digvijay Rathee and Chahat Pandey. The news of their inclusion has only amped up the anticipation, leaving fans eager to see how they perform on this new reality show. For the unversed, the duo shared a close bond during Bigg Boss 18, with Chahat being one of Digvijay’s closest friends after he entered the show as a wildcard contestant. With The 50 promising a unique format, it will be interesting to see how their equation translates into the game and how they navigate this new challenge together. About The 50 The 50 is being touted as an extremely unique reality show and is said to be nothing like Bigg Boss, despite assumptions suggesting otherwise. The hype around the show is sky-high, especially as it is already being called one of the biggest reality shows on Indian television. The format will bring together 50 celebrities under one roof for nearly 50 episodes, a scale that promises absolute chaos. After all, if fewer contestants in Bigg Boss can create this much drama, one can only imagine what 50 participants will bring to the table. Adding another interesting twist, the audience will also get to participate in the show. Viewers can choose contestants to support, and if their selected contestant wins, they will receive a share of the prize money. The show will be hosted by Farah Khan. Speaking about The 50, the director shared in a statement that reality shows in India have followed a similar pattern for years, and The 50 aims to break that mould. According to her, the scale is massive, the number of participants overwhelming, and the constant pressure will leave no room for comfort. That, she believes, is exactly what makes the show exciting. Farah said, “Comfort zone jasi cheez yahan exist hi nahi karti." She also added that after having judged almost every reality format, The 50 will change the way audiences perceive reality television. With such bold claims and an ambitious format, it will be interesting to see what The 50 truly brings to the table.
